items.statement: The independent calculation supports the authors' hypothesis for the origin of the Pd2Cl6 shoulder.
items.expected: The verdict is supportive when a broad shoulder near 3170 eV is traced to multiple Pd–Cl-involving transitions with large Pd d contributions.

items.statement: DFT-type calculations can reproduce the defining Pd2Cl6 spectral features within qualitative line-shape limits.
items.expected: The result identifies the principal line and lower-energy shoulder and treats feature identity/assignment as more reliable than exact linewidth or absolute uncalibrated energy.

items.statement: Broadening and model dependence limit exact line-shape interpretation.
items.expected: Limitations explicitly note sensitivity to broadening/alignment/model choice and do not claim exact experimental linewidth reproduction.
